closure_definition: delivery-owner dispatch consumes active canonical runtime state

acceptance_criteria.description: delivery owner dispatches only from active registry, current delivery-state, and readiness handoff inputs

priority_basis: delivery-owner must not dispatch work from stale or incomplete canonical state

protected_behaviors: delivery-owner dispatch preserves expert boundaries and passes QA handoff obligations downstream
business_constraints: do not enter delivery gate or commit during dispatch planning

verification_plan.business_operation: prepare the first delivery-owner dispatch batch
verification_plan.expected_observation: dispatch output includes active artifact refs, task dependency state, evidence expectations, and next action
